summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, deployed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as systemd service inventory-worker running under that account, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/service health, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-started (enabled) and is running as inventorysvc post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker and confirmed no prior inventory-worker service/inventorysvc account existed
Created system account inventorysvc (no shell, no home)
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
Verified service active/enabled and process owned by inventorysvc (PID 1978)
Captured baseline boot_id (f455a75c...) and service health before restart
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, safe native mechanism)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed to ac2ba0c4... proving actual restart
Verified post-restart: service active, enabled, running as inventorysvc (new PID 737), inventorysvc account intact

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker binary exists and is a simple long-running script suitable for a managed service
evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present at /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, executable POSIX shell script; no pre-existing inventory-worker unit or inventorysvc user

evidence.requirement: Dedicated inventorysvc account and inventory-worker systemd service created, enabled, and running under that account
evidence.summary: useradd created system account inventorysvc (uid 992); systemd unit written with User=inventorysvc; service enabled+started; systemctl status shows active/enabled and process tree owned by inventorysvc (PID 1978)
Captured pre-restart boot_id (f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c), uptime, and confirmed inventory-worker.service active with MainPID 1978

evidence.requirement: Node restarted via native safe reboot mechanism, single node, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: sudo systemctl reboot issued in background with disown; exec stream closed as expected once reboot proceeded, confirming acknowledgement was returned before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Node polled until command execution available again, and boot identity proven changed
evidence.summary: Two connection-timeout polls followed by a successful exec returning new boot_id ac2ba0c4-dcb8-4222-931a-a2770808d0ec, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, data, and account verified
evidence.summary: inventory-worker.service is active and enabled after reboot with a new MainPID (737) owned by inventorysvc; inventorysvc account still present, confirming service auto-start and account persistence across restart
